answer: Each epoch auctions a fixed supply of identity slots: a seat costs a refundable 25,000 POA bond plus a hardware TEE quote and a per-epoch VDF burn, so one device lights exactly one lantern in the registry. Duplicate fingerprints trigger seizure: 50% of the bond burned, 50% paid to the reporter, both identities banned 10 epochs. That widens the canyon between honest and sybil cost: 1,000 fake identities must lock 25,000,000 POA versus one honest fee, making fabrication capital-negative. Limitation: auctions cause a capital centralization ripple letting wealthy operators outbid newcomers.
